## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `dev` and targets `dev` (release PRs target `main`); branch named `imperix/vrx-XX-slug`, `imperix/<slug>` or a tool's own prefix
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat(vrx-XX): ...`, or `feat: ...` without an issue)
- [ ] The [development gate](https://github.com/Imperix1155/VRX/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#verification) passes, or the documented prose-only checks apply and are listed
- [ ] Review covers the final diff under [Review](https://github.com/Imperix1155/VRX/blob/main/docs/REVIEW.md), with evidence and limitations recorded
- [ ] DOX pass complete; changed and intentionally unchanged documentation identified (token changes ran `npm run design:tokens`)
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or PII logged; no hardcoded paths
- [ ] PR description explains what changed and links the issue, if any
